description: AGSC-09-09 as amended at rc.6 names `conform --level <n>`, the Level whose vector set runs (AGSC-10-01), and Levels are 0 to 3 (AGSC-10-02…05). A value outside that range is a usage error: the argument is invalid, so it is AGSC-E003 and exit 2 (AGSC-09-08), distinct from exit 1, which means findings or a failed gate. No vector is run and no report is written.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
